source.provider: Microsoft Planetary Computer Sentinel-1 RTC collection

measurement.statistic: median of finite, nonnegative parcel pixels in linear power

VV.productDescription: Terrain-corrected gamma naught values of signal transmitted with vertical polarization and received with vertical polarization with radiometric terrain correction applied.
VV.unitStatus: STAC omits unit, scale, and offset; values are summarized as stored gamma0 power, not dB.

VH.productDescription: Terrain-corrected gamma naught values of signal transmitted with vertical polarization and received with horizontal polarization with radiometric terrain correction applied.
VH.unitStatus: STAC omits unit, scale, and offset; values are summarized as stored gamma0 power, not dB.

processing.qualityRule: Product nodata, nonfinite, and negative pixels excluded; no speckle, terrain, or additional QA filtering applied by this workflow.
processing.interpretationLimit: C-band gamma-naught backscatter is affected by vegetation, moisture, roughness, geometry, polarization and processing; it is not a direct soil-moisture or stress measurement.
